$comment: Copy for the weekly boss (UI_DESIGN.md 2.7, spec: multi-part, untimed, losing costs nothing). Flavour lines come with the boss in the seed. Plain sentences, no exclamation marks.
title: Weekly boss
hpLabel: Boss health: {remaining} of {total} hidden cases still standing
rules: Untimed. Each hidden case you pass knocks out one segment, and the boss stays down only when all of them fall. Losing costs nothing; an unbeaten boss stays until you beat it.
inputsHidden: Breaking inputs stay hidden on boss problems; failures show the case tags and input size only.
